jobs.description:

At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.

As an AI Hub Project Lead in our Commercial Intelligence team at Flix, you can make an impact by driving AI-first transformation across the organization — leading high-impact initiatives that sit at the intersection of technical depth and organizational influence. You will work closely with a dedicated team across Data Science, Engineering, Marketing, and senior leadership to ensure our AI investments translate into measurable business outcomes at scale.

About the Role

- Own the end-to-end delivery of AI initiatives across the Commercial Intelligence organization: from scoping and prioritization through to production and adoption, defining clear success criteria and ensuring projects land on time with measurable impact

- Evangelize an AI-first culture within CI and across the wider organization — running workshops, sharing best practices, and building internal communities of practice that make AI tools and methods accessible to everyone

- Proactively identify, pilot, and scale AI use cases across CI and the broader organization, evaluating emerging AI tools and platforms and partnering with engineers and data scientists to turn proof-of-concepts into production-grade capabilities

- Manage cross-functional stakeholders — both technical and non-technical — aligning diverse teams and removing blockers to accelerate AI adoption across the business

- Translate complex AI concepts into clear, compelling narratives for senior leadership, marketing, and finance, making the technical accessible without oversimplifying

- Ensure the quality and rigour of attribution and measurement frameworks, acting as the connective tissue between technical teams building AI capabilities and the broader organization adopting them

About You

- Holds a Master's or PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field — or equivalent practical experience

- Brings 5+ years of experience in data science, AI/ML, or analytical roles, with a demonstrated track record of leading complex, cross-functional AI projects from conception to delivery

- Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously, align diverse stakeholders, and deliver results in a fast-moving environment

- Strong working knowledge of modern AI and ML methods, tooling, and best practices, with hands-on experience in Python and the broader data/AI ecosystem — including cloud platforms, MLOps, LLMs, and experimentation frameworks

- Genuinely passionate about AI and its potential to reshape how organizations work — you experiment constantly, share learnings generously, and bring others along on the journey

- Experience with causal inference or econometric methods, a background in digital marketing or growth analytics, or familiarity with vendor evaluation and AI governance frameworks is a plus

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!

- Hybrid work model : We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.

jobs.title: FP&A Manager
jobs.description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.

We are looking for a FP&A Manager to lead financial planning and performance management across the North America business. This is a hands-on role responsible for forecasting, budgeting, financial analysis, and reporting, working closely with the Head of FP&A and business partners across the organization.

The ideal candidate is a highly analytical finance professional who can build and maintain financial models, analyze business performance, and translate data into clear insights. A forward-thinking mindset is essential, including the ability to leverage AI tools and automation to drive efficiency and modernize existing reporting workflows.

About the Role

- Lead the annual budgeting, quarterly forecasting, and long-term planning processes for North America.

- Own monthly performance reporting and variance analysis for assigned business areas and functions.

- Build and maintain financial models to support forecasting, scenario analysis, and strategic business initiatives.

- Develop and track KPIs and operational metrics; translate financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for business stakeholders.

- Perform price, volume, mix, and driver-based analysis across business models to support decision-making and identify risks and opportunities.

- Partner with business leaders, Accounting, and Operational Finance to align on performance drivers, actual results, forecasts, and reporting.

- Identify and implement process improvements to FP&A tools and reporting workflows, leveraging AI and automation to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

- Support strategic and project-based financial analysis as needed.

About You

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field required.

- 5+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, corporate finance, or operational finance

- Experience in a structured finance training or rotational program strongly preferred.

- Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and analytical skills; advanced Excel proficiency.

- Strong understanding of P&L drivers, financial statements, and corporate finance principles.

- Proven ability to translate complex financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations.

- Experience partnering with senior business leaders and effectively communicating financial results and business drivers.

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!

What We Offer

- Comprehensive Wellness Coverage – Competitive Medical, Vision, and Dental plans, including multiple FSAs (Health and Dependent Care).

- 401(k) Matching – 401(k) plan with up to 4% company matching contributions.

- Flexible Time Off – Take time off when you need it, as you need it, subject to business needs and manager approval.

- Paid Parental Leave – 8 week s of fully paid leave to support new parents and growing families.

- Company Paid Life Insurance – Basic company-paid life insurance equal to your annual salary.

- Lifestyle Spending Account – Receive up to $600 per year for eligible lifestyle-related services.

- Tuition Support – Up to $5,250 per year reimbursed for your continued education and development after 12 months of continuous service.

- 24/7 Employee Assistance Program – Free, confidential support for mental health, legal, financial, and family issues, including up to 5 free counseling sessions per year.

jobs.title: Junior Technical Operations Manager – AI & Automation (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.

We are looking for a curious and driven Junior Technical Operations Manager with focus on AI & Automation who wants to build the operational backbone that lets us scale our platform globally with minimal resource investment. You will keep third-party partner inventory live on our platform while challenging how processes can be improved.

You will be part of a self-organized, cross-functional Platform Business Team where we test and launch new business models. This role starts from the same foundation as the rest of our Technical Operations team – integrating and maintaining partner inventory – and grows it in a new direction: using automation and AI to remove manual, repetitive work so the inventory can scale while remaining a stable team. Your work directly contributes to shaping the future of mobility.

About the Role

- Integrate and maintain partner inventory. You onboard third-party carriers onto our platform and keep their inventory accurate and healthy across our tools and integration modes (self-service, manual, hybrid, and API integration), the operational core our revenue and inventory growth depend on.

- Automate the repetitive. You identify manual, recurring steps in our onboarding and inventory processes and replace them with scripts, workflows, and automation so the team scales without scaling effort.

- Put AI to work. You prototype and apply AI tooling – from data checks and inventory QA to document handling and internal assistants – to speed up operations and improve quality of information.

- Be an expert user of our internal tools. You work closely with our engineer to resolve technical issues, improve the partner and customer experience, and turn recurring pain points into tooling improvements.

- Make it data-based. You use data to find where automation pays off, measure the impact of what you build, and prioritize the next opportunity.

About You

- Holds a degree in a technical, analytical, or business field – e.g. Business Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Business Administration, or similar with 3+ years of relevant experience.

- Comfortable with data and automation tooling – for example spreadsheets, SQL, scripting (e.g. Python), no-code/low-code automation, or hands-on experimentation with AI tools.

- You are a thorough, detail-oriented person who cares about clean, reliable data.

- You can set your own goals, structure your work to meet them, and find creative workarounds to meet stakeholder needs.

- You love an international environment and are a team player.

- You are fluent in English; any other language is a plus.

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!
